title: CrownThrive PentaRouter Survival Contract
production_invariant: A Penta is not production-capable merely because it is registered, can call a model, or can initiate a workflow. Persistent identity, persistent state, deterministic functions, queues, leases, recovery, evidence, authority enforcement, health behavior, model degradation, model replacement, and restart behavior must be declared, exercised, bound to an immutable exact subject, and independently verified.

persistent_identity.evidence: immutable node_id and exact source SHA

persistent_state.evidence: source-bound state and durable receipt projection

queues.evidence: warm durable queue and cold replay queue declarations

leases.evidence: lease owner, expiry, retry budget, and dead-letter disposition

authority_enforcement.evidence: DAIL, CHLOM, human-reserved D3, and provider boundary tests

health_behavior.evidence: health state, circuit breaker, capacity, and diagnostics

model_replacement.evidence: provider/model replacement cannot change contract identity or authority

restart_behavior.evidence: idempotency, queue recovery, lease recovery, and receipt replay tests

shutdown_thresholds: authority state is missing or contradictory
all eligible router nodes are unavailable
cold evidence ledger is unavailable for a side effect
provider readback cannot be obtained after a claimed side effect
recovery_acceptance_criteria: same immutable subject and source SHA
same or superseding generation without stale rollback
provider state read back where side effects occurred
independent certification receipt bound to exact subject
